25.original: Use the antidote to treat Runar's poison.

26.original: Offer Runar a second dose of the antidote.

27.original: Offer Runar a third dose of the antidote.

49.original: Why would she do such a thing?

50.original: Oh, Y'shtola... Had we been but a few steps faster.

51.original: We should have tried harder to repel them.

52.original: Almet. Please tell me you know if that hole might lead out into the woods somewhere.

53.original: Were there another means of exiting the temple, there is no question that we would know of it.

54.original: But I fear that is of little consequence, for we have tried to mark the depth of the pit. And failed.

55.original: To fall from such a height...

57.original: The Eulmoran soldiers and the Children have fled Yx'Maja.

58.original: They abandoned Slitherbough as well, though they yet remain in the swamps near Lakeland.

59.original: Unfortunately, a number of the Blessed were poisoned while fending off the soldiers.

60.original: One we believe to be of their order was found lost in Yx'Maja, feverish and badly wounded.

61.original: He was taken to Fanow for treatment, but I fear there is little we can do for him.

62.original: He and the other Blessed will not last long without an antidote.

63.original: Then we must act quickly. If you've a spare vial, Minfilia and I can deliver it to the Blessed at Slitherbough.

64.original: You and Urianger should return to Fanow and tend to the wounded villager there.

66.original: I know it seems callous of us to leave, but she leapt into that hole for a reason.

67.original: We have to save the Blessed. Whatever it takes.

69.original: My sisters and I will remain here. We must be certain no soldiers are still lurking about.

70.original: Come, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Let not Y'shtola's sacrifice be in vain.

74.original: 'Twas he who forestalled the Eulmorans' procession. And in so doing, afforded thee time to traverse the temple.

76.original: Quickly, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I fear he hath precious little time.

78.original: Runar still appears visibly pained. Perhaps he requires another dose of medicine.

79.original: The medicine seems to take effect as the color slowly creeps back to his cheeks.

81.original: It would appear the worst hath passed, though his wounds yet want for mending.

82.original: I shall minister to him forthwith.
